exact_contract.title: Implement pure versioned migration planning
exact_contract.goal: Parse and plan deterministic authored-format migrations while preserving owner syntax and values.
steps: Define a source-version registry with a frozen recognized epoch-less grammar and deterministic transform chain; unknown input is a typed refusal.
Retain a syntax-preserving representation for authored TOML/text so comments, ordering and owner selections survive planned edits.
Produce validated in-memory before/after diffs and typed NeedsInput for ambiguity; do not implement SourceDescriptor or feature-specific converters before their own reader atoms.
positive_cases: A recognized legacy fixture yields deterministic planned changes with comments/values preserved.
A current-format input yields an explicit no-op plan.
negative_cases: Unknown version, ambiguous selection and malformed syntax refuse before filesystem effects.
No LLM or heuristic default chooses missing authored intent.
checks: SELECT BEFORE DISPATCH: vibe-core target/cases are TO BIND from source/metadata to affected positive/negative obligations; choose --lib, --test <name>, --bin <name>, or affected --doc before compiling.

RUN BOUND CHECKS: after binding, use cargo test -p vibe-core <target> <case> -- --exact for lib/test/bin, or a reviewed small family without --exact; bind supported rustdoc selection separately. Verify intended nonzero cases in output; use target-specific --list only when needed to confirm selection, and reuse its valid inventory.

CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo xtask check-codegen only when the actual diff affects schemas, generators, generated-output registration or a dependent contract. Bind a narrower existing oracle if available; the global command needs that concrete impact and no adequate narrower check.

CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo xtask wire-diff only when the actual diff affects wire/format behavior, its corpus or epoch semantics. Bind a narrower existing oracle if available; the global command needs that concrete impact and no adequate narrower check.
acceptance: Repeated planning over exact input gives identical output/diff identity.
Fixture coverage demonstrates genuine transforms and no-op/ambiguity cases.
exact_contract.safe_stop: Pure executable migration planner is complete; no authored file changed by plan.
exact_contract.commit_subject: feat(migrate): plan deterministic syntax-preserving format changes
notes: Exact module/type/epoch names are settled inside this task's approved perimeter. SourceDescriptor converter belongs to M-06-A, feature converter to M-05-B.

Schema changes: inspect the existing codegen entrypoint before regeneration; never hand-edit generated types or invent a new codegen command. The listed check-codegen and wire-diff oracles are conditional on the actual affected inputs, never on the allowed write perimeter alone.
Registration perimeter includes existing crate manifests and module owners only for required exports/dependencies; do not change unrelated declarations.

limits: Synthetic positive fixtures; historical scalar refusal only
No source/features/Redbook recipe, transport or saved apply claimed
Pure public proposal is not authenticated write authority
